skillNarratives.title: Mechanical design

skillNarratives.text: I work with wiring, sensors, actuators, power routing, and controller behavior in the same system.

skillNarratives.text: I write code for MPF configs, hardware tests, embedded control, web tools, and debugging workflows.

skillNarratives.text: I use ChatGPT for planning, debugging, documentation, and code review, then check decisions against real tests.

items.text: Garden Party Pinball - full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST hardware, MPF, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and playfield revisions.
Smart Self-Watering Pot - moisture sensing, pump control, enclosure planning, and a custom PCB direction.
TETC 3D Printing Engineering Showcase - presentation on additive manufacturing, mechanical design, and robotics examples.
CAD Mechanism Studies - SolidWorks assemblies, mechanisms, print-ready parts, tolerance tests, and design notes.
FAST / MPF Hardware Test Tools - scripts and configs for switch, driver, LED, board-map, and hardware tests.
Subpix - open-source Electron/Vite/React/TypeScript desktop editor for .subpix files, RGB/BGR subpixel canvas editing, JSON validation, PNG export, and Windows installer packaging.

VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm - Stanford AI4ALL project built by a team of 10, connecting SolidWorks CAD, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target-based vision/control input, and robotic arm joint motion.
Check-ins - live Vercel app for logging consistency and tracking target/max gaps.
Desmos 3D Solar System - 3D math visualization using surfaces, orbits, color mapping, and performance-aware scene design.
TinyGPT Experiments - small language-model project focused on next-token prediction and instruction-following differences.
MIDI Practice Tool - Python music-practice utility for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard-style interaction.
Manim / presentation animation work - timed explanation visuals for presentations.
BetterQuizzer / quiz-app work - quiz-app development and debugging for hosted submission and persistence behavior.
3D printing workflow - Bambu Studio, material choices, iteration prints, print orientation, and fit testing.
Laser cutting workflow - design and fabrication planning for flat-cut parts and enclosures.
Home maker-lab practice - CAD, wiring, printing, scanning, electronics, and mechanical assembly.
VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype - robotics drivetrain build using gearing and packaging constraints around structure interference.
SolidWorks modeling - part design, assemblies, complex forms, and fabrication-oriented CAD decisions.
